hero.lead: We transform people management by combining HR expertise, cutting-edge technology, and artificial intelligence.
hero.desc: We assess, organize, and optimize HR processes. When the organization requires it, we incorporate our own technology to digitize, automate, and integrate HR management.

identity.introStrong: HR consulting firm specializing in people management
identity.intro2: , with 25 years of experience in industrial, FMCG, and SME sectors. Our in-house IT team allows us to integrate technology when it adds value to our solutions.
identity.pillar1Desc: We understand the organization, its people, and its processes. We assess, design, and implement HR solutions with professional criteria and close partnership.
identity.pillar2Desc: We convert processes into digital solutions. Our IT team automates workflows, integrates information, and develops custom HR tools.
identity.statement2: almost 30 years of HR expertise + proprietary technological capabilities.

hr.copy: We intervene in people management processes in a comprehensive or targeted manner, tailored to the reality and needs of each organization.

technology.title: Technology applied to HR.
technology.copy: Our IT team enables us to design and implement technological solutions directly linked to the people management needs of the organization.
technology.card1Desc: Centralize HR documents, employee files, processes, and information to facilitate access and management.
technology.card2Desc: Reduce repetitive tasks, operational errors, and administrative lead times.
technology.card3Desc: Connect data, processes, people, and systems within a unified HR ecosystem.
technology.card4Desc: Acquire and analyze information, assist in tasks, detect patterns, and generate HR metrics.
technology.humanAiCol1Desc: Organizes information, analyzes data, detects patterns, and generates insights for HR management.
technology.humanAiCol2Desc: Validate information, interpret context, define strategy, and make the final decision.

platform.lead: A multi-company HR platform built from real-world people management experience.
platform.copy: It integrates processes, information, and HR tools in a single environment. Its modular structure adapts to different organizational needs and growth stages.
platform.mod1Desc: Tools for comprehensive employee file management, documentation, and the employee lifecycle.
platform.mod2Desc: Advanced solutions for structure design, job profiles, and talent acquisition.
platform.mod3Desc: Performance management, training, workplace climate, and internal communication.
platform.mod4Desc: Time and attendance control, payroll variables, and tools to centralize payroll processing.
platform.portalDesc: Inquiries, documentation, requests, and communication in a cross-functional space.
